name: Tripod cauldron (ding)
dimensions: max dimensions: H. 13.7 x Diam. 12.2 cm (5 3/8 x 4 13/16 in.)
summary: Small cauldron with flared mouth, crimped waist, and three flat legs; red earthenware. Dawenkou culture. From the middle and lower Yellow River valley regions; Shandong, northern Jiangsu, northern Anhui, and eastern Henan provinces.
